messages.subject: Fwd: Intro R workshop tomorrow.
parts:
Hi all,

this is a resources request —

I’ve got ~50 people signed up for this workshop, and I’m planning on doing parts of this lesson:

http://data-lessons.github.io/gapminder-R/

(It will be recorded etc. etc.)

I’d like to provide information on what else is going on on campus around R, in particular. I already mention DRUG, of course! But what am I missing? For example, I have heard that there will be an R grad course next quarter… any links or pointers to this or any other events I should proselytize?

thanks,
—titus

p.s. I could use an extra TA or two if any are available, and I’m more than happy to find some co-teachers if people are really interested in practicing their teaching :).
